title: One spelling per player in the popularity table
description: catalog/ocn-1.popularity.tsv names the strongest player recorded on each line as a free string, and the corpus spelled many of them several ways. Two defects are corrected: a doubled full stop, which is pure formatting; and a given name truncated to an initial or mid-word where the same file carries the full form for the same surname and initial. The evidence is internal — the file disagreeing with itself — and the collapse only runs where every shorter form is a strict prefix of the longest. Where two forms are genuinely different given names they are left alone, and where the longest form carries a database disambiguator (Fedoseev, Vladimir2; Jovanovic, Zoran2) nothing is collapsed onto it, because that digit marks a specific person and merging would be worse than the defect.
